purpose: Teach: にもかかわらず/おっしゃら/あげれ/仰っ/当てはめ/まとまら/違わ/無き

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 業績悪化にもかかわらず、社員を守れ
lines.en: Protect our staff, even as performance declines.
lines.style: Clear, measured authority. Open with quiet conviction. Even pacing—no rush. The tone of someone stating principle, not preference. Slight pause weight on the key responsibility.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。先方、おっしゃらない条件があるかもしれません
lines.en: Yes. There may be conditions the other side hasn't mentioned yet.
lines.style: Careful, attentive phrasing. Lean slightly forward—bringing information forward. Steady pace, businesslike. The hesitation is professional caution, not uncertainty.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 社員にも昇給をあげればよかった
lines.en: I should have given the staff a raise, too.
lines.style: Quieter, reflective. A moment of self-examination. Slower pace—genuinely thinking aloud. Not regret performed for effect, but genuine reconsideration of past choice.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社長が仰った戦略、進めております
lines.en: Yes. We're implementing the strategy you outlined.
lines.style: Respectful but not deferential. Direct. Confirms action underway with steady eye contact. Professional warmth—showing he's heard and is acting on it.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、データを当てはめての分析を続けろ
lines.en: Our company will continue to analyze data against real results.
lines.style: Directive, measured. Lean back slightly—authority in composure. Even tone across the instruction. Deliberate, not rushed. The weight falls on 'continue'—this is ongoing work.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。意見がまとまらない会議を改善します
lines.en: Yes. I'll work to improve how we run those meetings—too many conflicting opinions aren't getting resolved.
lines.style: Acknowledgment with a plan. Moderate pace. The tone shows he's taken the implicit feedback and is committing to action. Not defensive—constructive.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社の方針は、業界平均と違わない
lines.en: Our approach aligns with industry standards.
lines.style: Steady, assuring. Even rhythm. This is positioning—a statement of fact offered to provide context or reassurance. Not defensive, but clear on footing.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。お得意様無きの月もあるかもしれません
lines.en: Yes. We may see months where there are no major accounts ordering.
lines.style: Pragmatic concern. Measured delivery of a difficult truth. Slight brace in the shoulders—readiness for the reality he's naming. Not alarmist, but honest about risk.
